scope: RewindBox Pocket originals: pubspec.yaml declares the assets/skins/pocket folder, the two approved original Dolphin skin packs (Wii Pocket, GameCube Pocket - Ivory) with their previews. Original RewindBox artwork; the third-party GameCube Pocket archive and artwork are not redistributed. tools/skins renders text with DejaVu fonts at generation time (tools/skins/fonts/DejaVu-notices.txt); no font file is bundled. No hosted package, dependency, engine, Core or native source change.
